name: country_allowlist
description: Prove your committed country code is one of the countries in a depth-8 Poseidon Merkle allowlist, without revealing which

salt.description: Random salt that hides the country in the public commitment

pathElements.description: Sibling hashes on the way from leaf to root, bottom-up

pathIndices.description: Per-level direction bits (0 = current is left child, 1 = right), bottom-up

commitment.description: Poseidon(countryCode, salt). Pre-committed so the holder cannot change country mid-flight

allowlistRoot.description: Merkle root of allowed countries (leaf = Poseidon(countryCode))
